page.overview:
Who is Corrin I Palaigo?

Emperor Corrin I Palaigo was the third Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 14–12 BG), succeeding his father Henoor I Salusa I as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Corrin I ruled for only two years before being succeeded by his son Saudir I.

The Schools of Dune series (part of the Expanded Dune canon by Brian Herbert and Kevin J. Anderson) names the third emperor of the Corrino Empire as Salvador Corrino, who is succeeded by his brother (not his son) Roderick Corrino.
